acquisition_rule: Acquire every ASCII CTD profile from both frozen listings, without selecting by water properties. Preserve all original bytes.
original_reference_rule: Filename nav denotes navigation reference; hr denotes bottom tracking. Preserve stated header/reference differences; do not combine alternatives as independent occupations.
inventory_rule: Validate the eight source columns and their units; pressure in dbar remains distinct from depth in metres. Preserve missing values and header conflicts.
source_quality_rule: Retain both complete author quality notes, including cruise-specific caveats. Typical +/-0.03m/s is not a per-cast confidence interval or a width error.
source_association_rule: Archive contains far-field observations too. Membership in this archive does not imply a descending Red Sea plume at every station.
source_support_visual: Show actual cast locations and cruise dates with separate campaigns and reference alternatives; no inferred channel envelope or current footprint.
next_gate: Use source methods and station geometry to specify independent cross-plume sections, layer/reference/tidal treatment and paired boundary rule before measuring. Winter and summer cruises are non-synoptic survey support, not a complete annual cycle.
source_reference_rule: CTD profiles are distinct from LADCP profiles. Join only by cruise and cast identifier, reporting source position and time differences; do not silently assume coincident measurement support.
companion_use: Characterize water-property support before proposed plume identity or width analysis. No salinity band is automatically a velocity-defined current width.
source_layer_note: Use distributed depth z in metres when comparing depth support; retain pressure p in dbar separately. Do not equate pressure with geometric depth.
ctd_ladcp_join_rule: Report source identifier matches and coordinate/time offsets without interpolating either profile or admitting a current association.
